description: This Java class implements a message mapper that executes JavaScript code (Rhino engine) to map incoming and outgoing messages within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It loads JavaScript scripts, manages execution context, and defines the mapping logic via script evaluation.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino
classes.description: A Rhino JavaScript engine-based message mapper for the Eclipse Ditto framework that performs message transformation using custom JavaScript scripts.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with JavaScript scripts and libraries, establishing execution environment.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects by executing the incoming JavaScript mapping logic.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessages using the outgoing JavaScript mapping script.

methods.name: initLibraries
methods.description: Loads required JavaScript libraries into the Rhino context.

methods.name: loadJavascriptLibrary
methods.description: Loads a JavaScript library into the Rhino context from a reader source.
